title: Grateful Dead Live at Musikhalle on 1972-04-29
lineage: AUD MR (poss. Uher Reel Machine at 4.75 cm/sec)> 2 reels> cass> SB Live!> .wav> .shn> CD-R

ai_review.summary: High‑energy Hamburg ’72 show captured on an excellent audience recording with a smoking Dark Star and tight Good Lovin’/Caution runs
ai_review.review: The April‑29‑1972 Hamburg concert is praised for its hot second set – a 30‑minute Dark Star, extended Playin' in the Band, and flawless Good Lovin'/Caution performances – while the audience tape delivers surprisingly clear, balanced sound that many say surpasses the board recordings.  Minor quirks like a slightly muted snap or early‑set quietness don’t detract from an overall stellar listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating ≈4.5, overwhelmingly positive comments on both performance and sound quality; large sample size (23 reviews) gives high confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, dynamic and well‑balanced tape with good hall acoustics; minimal crowd bleed, slight lack of brightness/snap noted by a few but overall superior to many board recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set considered less compelling with a few average cuts, but the band builds momentum; second set ignites with an epic Dark Star, flows into Sugar Magnolia and a tight Caution, delivering a high‑octane climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly noted as being in the groove with perfect tone and strong lead work throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned as locked into the groove alongside Jerry and Pigpen.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s playing highlighted on Dark Star, described as some of his finest work on the tour; also praised for jazzy passages.
